name: agentic-tw-legal-db
description: CLI-native Taiwan legal database access for Codex and terminal agents

interface.shortDescription: Query Taiwan legal sources through the twlaw CLI.
interface.longDescription: agentic tw legal db gives Codex and terminal agents a CLI-native interface for Taiwan public legal data: Judicial Yuan judgments, Ministry of Justice regulations, Constitutional Court data, MOJ legal-reference material, and official no-token open-data sources. It intentionally avoids MCP and uses stable JSON stdout for agent workflows.
